title: Dedra Meero
subtitle: Galactic Empire
description: Cold, calculating, and methodical, Dedra Meero has the qualities necessary for an ideal officer in the Imperial Security Bureau. It was Meero's ruthless attitude and her bold persistence that led her up the ladder of the organization. Dedra successfully assembled the pieces that led the Empire back to Ferrix and to the unorthodox conflict watiing there.
